成片时钟｜选定帧数 ÷ 窗口FPS

widgets_values:
H3素材台通用版｜操作方法

1. 加载素材  
点击“＋ 导入素材”，把图片、视频和音频加入素材池，再将需要使用的素材拖到对应轨道。

2. 排列素材  
同类素材按轨道从左到右编号：图片1、图片2……视频1、视频2……音频1、音频2……。图片轨只表示排列顺序，不占生成时长。提示词引用的编号，以最后一次“检测并对齐素材”的结果为准。

3. 裁剪片段、设置时长  
选中视频或音频，拖动片段两端进行裁剪，也可以填写“源入点 / 秒”和“源出点 / 秒”。视频和音频按同一时间线排好，“处理窗口”显示的总时长，就是输入工作流的生成时长。建议视频参考总长、音频参考总长和生成时长都控制在15秒以内，帧率保持24 FPS。

4. 截取图像、设置首尾帧  
将黄色播放头移到需要的画面，点击“截图”。截图会加入素材池，再把它拖到图片轨。在右侧素材设置中，将对应图片勾选为“首帧”或“尾帧”；只用作首尾帧时，取消“参考图片”勾选。做首尾帧生成时，请关闭“输出帧数对齐”，避免最后的画面被裁掉；成片时长可能略长于预设。

5. 一键对齐、直接生成  
在“提示词直输入”节点填写提示词，点击“检测并对齐素材”。按照检测后显示的 <Picture 1>、<Video 1>、<Audio 1> 等编号引用素材，检查通过后运行，无需反推。更换素材、调整顺序、裁剪片段或修改时长后，都要重新检测对齐。

detailed_description:
A premium software advertisement with cinematic graphite and navy backgrounds, restrained cyan light, luminous glass panels, and crisp ivory Chinese typography. Keep all specified target text rigid and readable. Preserve source wording except for the explicit <Picture 4> subtitle replacement. The product title “素材台无反推H3工作流” identifies a version with no connected prompt-rewriting stage; it does not promise that prompt preparation is unnecessary. Do not depict the alignment control as generating, rewriting, or completing prompts. Animate surrounding graphics with controlled depth and precise movement. Use clean cuts, without morphing characters, adding captions, or replacing the posters with real-world footage.

[Shot 1] Open on the complete front-facing composition of <Picture 1>. The large centered title “素材台无反推H3工作流” is immediately readable. Mountain, coast, and city cards float above the title; the three timeline tracks remain below it. A thin cyan highlight travels along the cards' borders, and the waveform gently pulses. Make a shallow, slow camera push while preserving every word inside the frame. At 00:00.400, a clear adult Mandarin female voice-over (S1), warm and confident, says <d>[Mandarin Chinese] H3素材台.</d> Finish before 00:02.000. A soft electronic pulse accompanies the opening glow.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, cut to <Picture 2>. Preserve “统一素材整理” and “图片 · 视频 · 音频” at the center. The upper image, video, and audio cards move a short distance toward the cyan guide, while corresponding tiles below slide neatly into their three separate tracks. Their movement ends with precise, satisfying alignment. Keep the headline stationary and the camera nearly fixed; all activity stays above and below the text. From 00:02.800 to 00:05.600, the same voice-over (S1) says <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 图片、视频、音频, 统一整理.</d> Three delicate placement clicks mark the settled categories.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, cut to <Picture 3>. The cursor gives the existing alignment control one compact click. A cyan pulse travels down the vertical guide; the numbered reference cards and timeline connection points illuminate in sequence, settling into the referenced aligned composition. Keep “一键对齐” and “编号清晰 · 提示词直输入” crisp and stable. Use a very slight inward camera movement, then hold the completed layout. From 00:06.300 to 00:09.100, voice-over (S1) says <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 一键对齐, 提示词直接输入.</d> A clean confirmation chime follows the click and alignment pulse.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.500, cut to <Picture 4>. Preserve “首尾可控” and “音轨可选”. Display the corrected subtitle “自由组合 · 提示词自备” in place of the source subtitle, matching its original typeface, size, and position. First illuminate the dawn endpoint card, then the brighter morning endpoint card. A short light trace travels through the connecting filmstrip without changing the original landscape images. The audio control receives one subtle highlight, and its waveform pulses softly. Keep the camera steady and each action distinct. From 00:09.800 to 00:12.200, voice-over (S1) says <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 首尾可控, 音轨可选.</d> Gentle interface ticks accompany the two endpoint highlights.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.500, cut back to the full composition of <Picture 1>. The complete brand title and subtitle dominate the center, with the surrounding media cards settled. From 00:12.650 to 00:14.500, voice-over (S1) says <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 提示词自备，直接输入。</d> Ease into a steady final hold, keeping the title fully visible through 00:15.000. A restrained cyan halo and a short musical resolution conclude the advertisement.

overall_soundscape:
A studio-clean sound bed with soft placement clicks, delicate interface ticks, and one alignment-confirmation chime. All effects stay below the clear Mandarin narration. No crowd noise, extra speakers, or additional spoken words.

non_diegetic_music:
Original modern electronic advertising music at approximately 112 BPM, with soft synthesizer pulses, rounded bass, and sparse crisp percussion. Build gently through the demonstrations, keep the music quieter beneath narration, and resolve by 00:14.700 with a brief tail through 00:15.000. No singing or lyrics.
